# PR #3438: Patch: every Meditative+ and Training Grounds card drawn as what it is: a scene of its own for each, richer the rarer

Closes #3393

## What changed

All 94 entries of Meditative+ and Training Grounds now draw a scene of their own, built from their brief, on both the base and the Radiant face. That is 33 Meditative+ entries with their tokens, 41 Training Grounds entries of the set's own with the Golem token, and 20 Legacy cards. The 48 of them that were on `ART_DETAIL_SHORT` are off it, and its cap `ART_DETAIL_SHORT_MAX` drops from 445 to 397, as #3390 lowered it.

- **Recipes.**
  - Meditative+ is in `sceneRecipesMeditativePlus.ts`, which spreads `sceneRecipesMeditativePlus2.ts` (#12–#26).
  - Training Grounds is in `sceneRecipesTrainingGrounds.ts`, which spreads `sceneRecipesTrainingGrounds2.ts` (the Units from #21 on, and #39-1).
  - The Legacy cards are in `sceneRecipesLegacy.ts`, with `LEGACY_TOUCH_PARTS`.
  - Meditative+ scenes use ink-wash peaks and exactly one red seal in the near layer. Training Grounds scenes use the carved yard (palisade and sand) with the sun at the upper right.
- **Units are characters.** Every Unit is a figure-kit figure; none uses the default look or `ownSubject`.
  - Potions are `outfit-flask` + `head-eyes`.
  - The totem, Floodgates and Training Dummy stand on `pose-post`.
  - The Golem is `outfit-posts` + `head-sack`; the Shredder is `pose-treads` + `outfit-machine`.
  - Other characters are `extras`, which is what `main` calls the plan's `crowd`. Ghosts and copies use the new `fade`.
- **Kit parts.**
  - New scene-kit modules: `sceneKitMountain.ts` (38 parts), `sceneKitYard.ts` (35) and `sceneKitTouches.ts` (14).
  - Figure kit: 4 poses, 3 heads, 6 hairs and headgear, 9 outfits, and 10 held items (club, axe, boulder, wand, ladle, purse, brush, oar, pointer, lance).
- **Legacy cards (R3393001).** Each draws its own scene through `legacySceneSvg`. It places its yard touch exactly once and wears its Core card's frozen emblem. It is still one picture and never shows its Core card's scene; `legacySvg` and the yard painter are now only the fallback for a card with no recipe.
- **Spec and docs.** Rulings R3393000 and R3393001, `spec/pending/3393.md`, "Amended by" paragraphs on R2202000, R2724000 and R3331000, the `--visual` fragment, and ART.md.
- **Pixel spec.** `e2e/cypress/component/set-scenes.cy.tsx` shows the 27 Epic/Legendary/Mythic cards at hand size and the other 67 as a contact sheet, at 1280×720 and 390×844.

## Tests I had to change, and why none is weaker

- **`scene.test.ts`, "R3331000 every part draws clean shapes from any seed".** The bigger kits now draw about 82,000 shapes here. With five `expect`s per shape the test took 3.8 s on its own and timed out at 5 s under suite load. Drawing alone takes 0.46 s. The test now collects every flaw into a list and asserts the list is empty once. The conditions are exactly the same, and it runs in about 1 s. I left the timeout alone.
- **`classicPlusScenes.test.ts`, the kit-modules count.** Its total count of `SCENE_KIT` now includes the three new modules. `setScenes.test.ts` gains a matching test for #3393's modules: no id appears in two modules, every part is in `SCENE_KIT`, and none replaces an older part.
- **`set-scenes.cy.tsx`.** The pixel check now lists every face on a page that changes too little under Radiant, instead of stopping at the first one. The 0.25 threshold is unchanged.

| `pnpm exec vitest run src/cards/art src/cards/depth.test.tsx` | 17 files, 263 tests passed (includes `setScenes`, `artRichness`, `art`, `scene`, `traininggrounds`, `depth`) |

| `cypress run --component --browser chrome --spec cypress/component/set-scenes.cy.tsx` | 5 passing |
| `cargo jackioh spec check` | 1841 rulings: ok |
| `patches check`, `catalog check` | ok |
| `classify --base origin/main --claims` | `Cards, micro` / how cards look changed |

- **Pixel spec.** The first Cypress runs failed because Radiant changed only 24.9% of Living Armor Potion's pixels and 21.1% of Living Health Potion's, under the 25% threshold. Their warm wooden hut walls are now grey stone (`slate-700`), and the spec then passed. I looked at all 15 screenshots.
- **Size cap.** Goetzmann Game Design (`traininggrounds-040`) was over the 48 KB `ART_DETAIL_MAX_BYTES` at 53 KB. With a carved pole, a target and two pixel scatters removed it is 46/47 KB and 165 elements, still over the Mythic floor of 140.
- **Scratch tests.** The `zz-*.test.ts` scratch tests are deleted.

## Decisions the issue left open

- **Split recipe files.** Each set's recipes are in two files, as Classic+ split its own, rather than one large file per set. This let the work go in parallel, and each set still has one table, which `setScenes.test.ts` checks.
- **Reused parts instead of the plan's new ones**, to keep the kits from duplicating what they already had:
  - `stairs`, `house`, `bookshelf`, `flowers`, `weights`, `slate-board` (the chalk-tally touch)
  - `item-flask` for the bottle, `item-dagger` for the knife, `item-banner` for the pennant

- **The Legacy link** is the brief's subject, the Core card's frozen emblem and the yard touch. I rejected also drawing the Core card's old subject in the scene: for a Unit that subject is the generic silhouette this issue retires.

- The `scene.test.ts` refactor described above.

## What it does

Part of #3330. Blocked by #3331, whose art bible, scene kits and detail floor this pass uses.

On 2026-11-06 the owner asked for every card's art to be more unique and richer, in its set's style: simpler for small cards, elaborate for Mythics. Spells and Field Spells in particular should be real scenes, not a few glyphs over a sky. This pass gives every Meditative+ and Training Grounds entry in the table below a scene recipe (#3331), drawn from its brief.

### Today (measured on `main` at `f330f5b`)

- Meditative+'s entries draw from the procedural painter, which sits at a median of 17 to 18 SVG elements at every rarity across its sets; 22 of this group's procedural entries have no motif.
- Training Grounds' painter (`traininggrounds.ts`, R2202000) draws its yard at 47 to 60 SVG elements by rarity, flat across rarities, and its 20 Legacy cards draw their Core card's subject in the yard (R2724000). The Legacy cards keep their link to their Core card's subject, now in a scene of their own.

### What it should be

- **Every entry gets a recipe.** Each entry in the table draws from a scene recipe of its own, base and Radiant, in its set's art-bible look, at or above its rarity's detail floor (#3331). Every entry leaves `ART_DETAIL_SHORT`.
- **A brief is the target, not a script.** The builder may change a detail to fit the kit, but the subject, the setting and the card's idea stay. When a brief names something the kit lacks, the part joins the kit.
- **Units become characters.** A Unit draws its character from the figure kit, never the generic silhouette.
- **Owned elsewhere** (left out of this table): none.
